prompt: This repo is built to be driven by coding agents — read AGENTS.md first. If .env is missing, copy .env.example, set BETTER_AUTH_SECRET, then run `pnpm -F db db`, `pnpm db:push`, `pnpm db:seed`. The `turso` CLI must be on PATH (brew install tursodatabase/tap/turso).

hooks.command: [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = "true" ] && cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { [ ! -x /opt/node24/bin/node ] || { export PATH="/opt/node24/bin:$PATH"; [ -z "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] || echo 'export PATH="/opt/node24/bin:$PATH"' >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; }; } && pnpm install || true
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && pnpm exec ultracite fix --hook
sid=$(sed -n 's/.*"session_id" *: *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | cut -c1-8); [ -z "$sid" ] || ! command -v agent-browser >/dev/null || agent-browser --session "$sid" close >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
